system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: feed the log window plus a system prompt (which references the 22-class failure taxonomy of §7) to an LLM completion call
system_prompt_style.note: Paper only. The Analyzer uses a system prompt plus a log window. Pitfall context is also surfaced, so the prompt may be dynamically_composed.

env_context_strategy.note: Paper only, no config surface. Skills and pitfalls are injected, but the paper gives no mechanism for how the agent learns about the environment.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: with a hardcoded 4 KB truncation window per source

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: The Router then emits a JSON envelope ({intent, business_line, p_date, model_ variant, overrides?} ) that is validated against a Pydantic schema
tool_call_format.note: The Router emits a JSON intent and a skill name; dispatch is deterministic.

tool_count.note: 29 skills are reported, but they are dispatched subgraphs, not model tool schemas.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Each skill's SKILL.md declares a frontmatter description field consumed by the Router LLM

protocol_standardization.note: Paper only, no dependency list available.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The agent tier is invoked by life- cycle events (IM webhook, HITL card callback, training-completion sentinel)
loop_primitives.note: The LangGraph DAG is a fixed pipeline with an Analyzer-to-retry repair loop.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: decomposes a request into a sequence of skill invocations
planning_granularity.note: The DAG is fixed and the plan is not a model-produced object; `implicit` could also be argued.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: we share the multi-step orchestration pattern but discard the role-specialized agent metaphor — our nodes are pipeline stages, not personas

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: our nodes are pipeline stages, not personas

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: control does not return to the DAG until an authorized operator approves or rejects the Analyzer's proposed remediation
human_in_loop.note: on_completion covers the threshold card in Business C.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: We use a single Pydantic state ob- ject (PipelineState) persisted as JSON in SQLite via aiosqlite.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: A rule-based extractor compiles these tables into a single SQLite-backed PitfallStore.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: resumes a paused DAG by reading PipelineState from SQLite, applying the operator's approval, and continuing from the paused node.

self_verification.evidence_quote: sandboxed unit tests in the training subgraph
self_verification.note: The paper calls this a team convention, not a hard gate.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Runs already attempted for this job, gates automatic retry cap

termination_condition.note: The DAG ends at Done or on rejection; none of the listed termination values fits.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: The agent's only writes are JSON-RPC create_task / start_task / the workflow API / resource upload calls
execution_isolation.note: Execution goes to borrowed infrastructure; the paper explicitly discards the Docker sandbox.

permission_model.evidence_quote: no executive action is taken without explicit operator approval

tracing.evidence_quote: Per-command breakdown from the CLI-call telemetry

replayability.evidence_quote: a re-execution of any node from the persisted state is well-defined

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: The benchmark harness has been implemented under tests/analyzer_taxonomy_bench.py

guardrails.evidence_quote: Envelope-level validation errors return an inline error card to the user rather than start- ing the DAG
guardrails.note: action_policies: a confidence below 0.4 disables approve.

target_domain.evidence_quote: an LLM-agent platform for indus- trial recommender lifecycle operations

first_release_date.note: Date is the paper v1 fallback.

pinned_version.note: No repository; the paper reports v1.0.
